high_level_description: The image shows a person wearing a white headscarf with red and gold trim around the edges. The headscarf is tied neatly, covering most of their hair and part of their face. They are also wearing a dark blue face mask that covers their mouth and nose. The individual is dressed in a black T-shirt featuring a colorful design on the front, which appears to be a peacock feather pattern in shades of blue, green, yellow, and orange.
